subject: MAP — procurement/legal stitching & vendor onboarding runway
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@greenleafhealth.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@procurex.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP — procurement/legal stitching & vendor onboarding runway

Hi all,

Thanks for joining today's MAP checkpoint. Below is a concise summary of where procurement/legal vendor onboarding stands for Greenleaf and the open asks we surfaced in the call. Attaching the latest MAP tracker (Greenleaf_MAP_v3.xlsx).

Quick summary:
- Goal: Execute MSA + Order Form and complete vendor setup by end of month to hit production pilot the first week of July.
- Biggest blockers: (1) legal redlines on indemnity/data residency, (2) payment terms in order form, (3) vendor portal invitation and bank setup.

Meeting notes / agreements:
- Legal (Laura): will provide a marked-up MSA with rationale for the remaining clauses and propose a single alternative for indemnity language.
- Procurement (Naomi): will send the vendor onboarding checklist and bank form; can fast-track vendor portal invite once redlines are accepted.
- Sales (Sean/Karthik): will hold commercial position on payment terms (Net 45 vs Net 30) and confirm if we can offer a one-time onboarding credit.

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Laura to upload redline summary + annotated MSA PDF — due: 2027-06-12 EOD. (attachment expected)
2) Naomi to open vendor record in vendor portal and send onboarding checklist + bank info template — due: 2027-06-13 noon PT.
3) Sean/Karthik to confirm final order form payment term and whether onboarding credit applies — due: 2027-06-13 EOD.
4) Tessa to schedule final redline review call (15m) once MSA is uploaded — tentative 2027-06-14.

Please reply inline for clarifications. If anything here doesn't match what you heard in the call, flag it and I'll update.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Lead, Growth
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Greenleaf_MAP_v3.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alice Moreno <alice@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP — procurement/legal stitching & vendor onboarding runway

Tessa / Alice —

Uploading the redlines now. Summary of the principal outstanding points:

1) Indemnity and consequential damages — Greenleaf requested to remove cap for certain data-related harm. Our preference is a limited carve (liability cap tied to fees; narrow exceptions for gross negligence). I have proposed alternative language in the attached PDF (MSA_redlines_20270611.pdf) with tracked comments under each clause.

2) Data residency & audit rights — Laura: Greenleaf needs clarity on where logs and model telemetry are stored. I've added a short clause pointing to our SOC2 + how we handle audit requests; this should be acceptable with an agreed notice window.

3) Export control / regulatory compliance — minor edits suggested.

I intentionally kept the set of proposed edits minimal to avoid re-litigation of core commercial economics. If procurement wants a concession on payment terms, we should consider reciprocity in the indemnity/accountability language.

Attachment: MSA_redlines_20270611.pdf (redline + short memo)

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP — procurement/legal stitching & vendor onboarding runway

Thanks, Tessa — and thanks Laura for the redline. A couple quick clarifying questions from procurement's side so we can avoid back-and-forth:

- On the indemnity alternative: can you send the exact recommended replacement language as plain text in the body? Our legal team prefers to see the clause inline rather than a PDF.
- Order form: Jordan is asking where payment terms will live. Do we sign MSA + order form together (preferred) or sign MSA first and order form later? We also need a statement of expected billing start date for project-phase milestones.
- Vendor setup: ProcureX requires a signed W-9 + vendor portal invite. Can Naomi confirm whether Redwood can provide ACH info and what the timeline is for portal activation?

Happy to jump on a 15m call if that helps.

Regards,
Alice Moreno
Head of Procurement
Greenleaf Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-12T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP — procurement/legal stitching & vendor onboarding runway

Hi Alice / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear asks. Vendor onboarding steps + estimated SLAs from Redwood:

1) Vendor intake form (Naomi) — I will email the intake + W-9 template to Jordan by EOD 6/12. SLA: same business day.
2) Bank details (ACH) — we provide standard bank remit instructions after W-9 is returned and vendor is approved. SLA: 1 business day post-approval.
3) Vendor portal invite — requires vendor record creation and internal approval. If Laura confirms legal approval on the MSA redline today, I can mark as high priority and issue the invite by 6/13 morning.
4) SOC2 / security evidence — we will link the SOC2 report and provide a read-only audit folder via Drive (link in MAP tracker).
5) Payment terms & billing start — Naomi: we can mirror the Order Form payment term agreed in commercial. If Greenleaf requests Net 45, we will flag for finance approval (may add a day or two).

Action owners / immediate next steps:
- Naomi: send intake + W-9 to Jordan (ProcureX) — ETA: 2027-06-12 EOD.
- Laura: paste indemnity replacement into email body and confirm if the MSA in the PDF is final — ETA: 2027-06-12 5pm PT.
- Sean/Karthik: confirm payment term (Net 30/Net 45) and whether onboarding credit applies — ETA: 2027-06-13 EOD.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5236123 (MAP-421)
MAP tracker (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Perfect, thanks everyone for the quick turnaround today. Closing the loop with the following confirmations and next steps:

- Laura: please paste the indemnity replacement into reply-all (as Naomi requested) — once we have that in the body we can avoid a separate PDF roundtrip.
- Naomi: thanks for the vendor onboarding timeline. Jordan: expect the W-9 + intake from Naomi shortly.
- Commercial: Sean/Karthik, if you can confirm payment term by EOD tomorrow (6/13) I'll lock that into the order form and schedule the final sign-off.

I will set a 15-minute redline review at 8:30am PT on 2027-06-14 (calendar invite to follow) — goal is to sign MSA + Order Form by 6/16 and complete vendor portal activation by 6/17 so we can start the pilot on 7/1.

If there are any changes to owners or timeline, flag immediately. Otherwise I'll circulate an updated MAP tracker and send the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Tessa
Enterprise Lead, Growth
Redwood Inference
